build_tile_manager_from_bbox: build a TileManager from a bounding box by downloading OSM data and rendering raster map tiles
query_tile_manager_canvas: query a TileManager with a bounding box to retrieve a Canvas with the composited raster image
create_map_index_spatial_query: create a MapIndex from MapData to spatially query nodes, lines, and areas by bounding box
save_tile_manager_pickle: save a TileManager to disk as a pickled file with PNG-encoded raster tiles and metadata
load_tile_manager_from_pickle: load a TileManager from a pickled file restoring tiles, projection, and bounding box metadata
